label: letter b in the sequence: after b in the original phase, and around outputting b in the copy phase
explanation: Tied to the letter b. In the original phase it fires from t>=2 on the inputs that come after a b, peaking about 1-3 steps after it. The strongest activations (~1.0) come in sequences that start with b, especially repeated b b b. In the copy phase it fires at <DEL> and the first copy steps when b is the current or next output (out_tok=b: 76% active, 10x lift; next_out=b: 8.6x), and it drops off once the b tokens have been output. Sequences starting with h give a weaker version of the same pattern (first_tok=h: 3.1x lift). Never fires at t=0 or t=1, and rarely late in the copy phase. A diffuse low-magnitude background (mostly <0.2 of max) at <DEL> and the early copy steps of sequences without b is not captured. That background, plus the b-sequences where it stays silent, keeps dev F1 at about 0.54 (mass recall 0.67).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=b (+4.41), orig1=b (+3.54), orig2=b (+3.13), next_out=b (+2.82), phase=2 & out_tok=b (+2.58), orig0=h (+2.47). Lower it: phase=2 & in_tok=t (-7.13), prev2_tok=- (-6.74), out_tok=t (-5.35), phase=2 & in_tok=a (-5.00).
